children: Please see attached half-year report prepared in compliance with the bond terms.
The consolidated profit and loss statement shows a turnover of 53 MDKK and a net loss of 21 MDKK for the period.
The figures are primarily a result from the partial sale of the Havdrup project in April and accrual of financing costs.
The unrestricted cash balance is roughly unchanged since end of 2025. The main investments during period has been towards the Holbæk project.
The figures are according to the management’s expectations.

Gefion Group is a Copenhagen-based real estate development company established in 2013. The Group is an experienced developer with an integrated team covering development, construction, legal and finance.

title: Gefion Group Holdco ApS - H1 2026 Half-year financial report
